purpose: Determine whether V50's common-domain extreme-density failure is caused by bounded-mixture probability in train-unoccupied support margins, conditional amplification by the frozen structure-risk channel, bounded PIT overdispersion, or a voxel log-score information ceiling, without changing support, thresholds, model parameters, or any sampled development artifact.

audit_population.model: unchanged V50 EMA checkpoint in evaluation mode

exact_native_voxel_diagnostics.scope: every 64^3 native train voxel in every frozen train object
metrics: truth counts and fractions in each fixed lower and upper support boundary layer
mean model probability mass in each fixed lower and upper support boundary layer
truth counts and mean model probability below the frozen global and per-domain train minima and above the frozen global and per-domain train maxima
mean exact bounded-mixture NLL and upper q99 and q99.9 mean NLL
bounded PIT lower and upper observed-over-expected ratios through probability 1e-6
mean mixture weights and posterior truth responsibilities by component
upper q99 and q99.9 posterior truth responsibilities
exact_native_voxel_diagnostics.probability_evaluation: analytic latent Gaussian-mixture CDF after the exact frozen bounded-logit transform; no sampling, clipping, or extrapolation

fixed_probe_posterior_predictive.probe_indices: reuse V46 seed 146046 and exactly 4096 native voxels without replacement per train object
fixed_probe_posterior_predictive.uniform_seeds: 151051 plus member, 10000000 times domain index, and 10000 times object index
fixed_probe_posterior_predictive.inverse: unchanged V50 28-step latent Gaussian-mixture inverse followed by the exact bounded transform, with rank epsilon 1e-7
comparisons: standardized residual posterior-predictive versus probed train truth
log10rho posterior-predictive versus probed train truth
sampled mean delta squared versus probed train truth

fixed_bounded_moment_quadrature.probe: the same fixed 4096 native train voxels per object
fixed_bounded_moment_quadrature.primary_rule: 64-point Gauss-Hermite quadrature independently for every predicted latent Gaussian component in float64
fixed_bounded_moment_quadrature.convergence_control: repeat aggregate moments with 32-point Gauss-Hermite quadrature
metrics: analytic bounded E[rho], E[rho^2], and E[(rho-1)^2] averaged over probed train conditions
per-component fractions of E[rho^2] and E[(rho-1)^2]
fractions of E[rho^2] and E[(rho-1)^2] contributed above the frozen global and per-domain train residual maxima
fractions of E[rho^2] and E[(rho-1)^2] contributed by each fixed upper support boundary layer
analytic versus empirical probed mean delta squared

variables: query backbone physical y before standardized residual
standardized V41 full extreme-structure block-risk input channel
fixed_conditional_strata.boundaries: train-only fixed-probe quantiles q90, q99, and q99.9 computed independently within each domain
metrics: quadrature over empirical mean delta squared
model probability above the frozen global train residual maximum

fixed_branches.condition: at least two domains predict at least 10 native train voxels above the frozen global train residual maximum and assign at least 0.5 of quadrature rho squared to residuals above that maximum

the q99.9-and-above structure-risk stratum has quadrature over empirical mean delta squared above 1.5 in at least two domains and the already sealed structure-risk ablation reduces development mean delta squared ratio relative to the candidate in every domain
at least two domains have upper PIT observed-over-expected below 0.5 at probability 1e-5 while posterior-predictive q99.999 or quadrature mean delta squared fails its frozen band in every domain
any domain has global effective posterior-responsibility component count below 3.0 or a component with mean weight at least 0.02 and responsibility-to-weight ratio below 0.5
all domains pass lower and upper PIT at probability 1e-5 and posterior-predictive q99.999, but any domain has quadrature mean delta squared outside [2/3,1.5] times empirical truth
every domain passes lower and upper PIT at probability 1e-5, posterior-predictive q99.999, and quadrature mean delta squared ratio in [2/3,1.5]

hard_checks: clean committed worktree and exact V50 result record, program, support, checkpoint, report, cache, preflight, and development-decision hashes and canonical digests
Lageunha Ada GPU and exact V50 parameter count
all train object, native voxel, and fixed probe counts exactly match this program
the support remains exactly [-13.78839653180272,10.259036149654781] and every observed train target remains strictly interior
all model parameters, bounded NLL, PIT, responsibilities, analytic probabilities, quadrature moments, and sampled values are finite
mixture weights and posterior responsibilities sum to one within 1e-5
aggregate 32-point versus 64-point quadrature relative differences remain below 0.005
the one recorded step-8400 recoverable AMP overflow and non-standard Infinity token are acknowledged without modifying the sealed report
